CalendarSubscription.title: Calendar subscription
CalendarSubscription.subtitle: The sessions of the courses you are enrolled in are added to your Google or Apple calendar by themselves; sessions that move or are cancelled are updated too.

CalendarSubscription.howTitle: How to add it to your calendar
CalendarSubscription.googleStep2: Click the plus next to “Other calendars” on the left, then “From URL”.
CalendarSubscription.googleStep3: Paste the link for Google Calendar and click “Add calendar”.
CalendarSubscription.googlePhone: The Google Calendar app on a phone cannot add a calendar by URL. Once you add it from a computer it shows on your phone too.
CalendarSubscription.appleStep1: On an iPhone or iPad, tap “Open in Apple Calendar”.
CalendarSubscription.appleStep3: On a Mac, in the Calendar app choose File › New Calendar Subscription and paste the link for Apple Calendar.
CalendarSubscription.delayText: Google refreshes subscribed calendars on its own schedule; a changed session can take a few hours to show. For last-minute changes, look at the session page.
CalendarSubscription.what1: The sessions of the courses you are enrolled in: from 30 days back to 180 days ahead.
CalendarSubscription.what2: A session that moves is updated; a cancelled session shows as cancelled in your calendar.
CalendarSubscription.what3: Meeting links are not written into the calendar. Every entry links to the session page, where the meeting link is.
CalendarSubscription.what4: If you leave a course, or lose access to it, its sessions drop out of your calendar.
CalendarSubscription.privateText: Anyone who knows the link can see your course names and session times. Do not share it; if you did, renew it.
